name: Permanent minions are stowed during a taxi flight and return on landing
contract: CoA decision: minions that last until dismissed must not follow their owner along a taxi route, where they
would run through the zones below and pull everything on the way. AscensionCompanionFlight stows them when
the owner boards and summons them back beside the owner on landing; hunter and warlock pets are not affected.
Expected: a level 60 Necromancer's Greater Skeletal Warrior (504901, creature 51065) is gone within a few
seconds of the Stormwind - Lakeshire flight starting and stays gone while it lasts, the owner is not pulled
into combat on the way, and after landing the warrior is summoned again. Upstream's
necromancer-minions-mounted-7457 asserts the opposite for the flight and contradicts this decision.

steps.label: SETUP: the Greater Skeletal Warrior is summoned
The minion stays stowed during the flight
Nothing on the way pulled the owner into combat
After landing the minion is summoned again
